name: El Dorado Casitas Royale
tagline: Unique swim-out casitas with private plunge pools
description: The only resort in the region offering swim-out casitas with individual private plunge pools — each suite opens directly onto a lazy river and communal swim area. AAA Four Diamond rated. The boutique scale ensures deeply personalised service and maximum privacy, making it the undisputed #1 choice for honeymoons and anniversary celebrations.
highlights: ONLY resort in region with swim-out casitas and private plunge pools
Each casita connects to a lazy river and communal pool
AAA Four Diamond rated — guarantees service standards
Expedia 9.3/10 — couples rate it top for two-person trips
Boutique scale = deeply personalised, highly attentive service
Staff described as professional, discreet, and accommodating
Perfect for honeymoons — resort specialises in milestone celebrations
considerations: Fewer dining variety options vs. larger resorts
Ground-floor casitas: neighbour visibility is a concern for some
Remote location — limited off-resort activity access

reviews.name: Scott S
reviews.text: AVOID! I've been a Diamond Member with Exotic Travelers Club for 23 years, paying over $50,000 in membership fees. On this trip we were told our benefits would not be honored because we booked on Lomashospitality.com instead of Exotictravelers.com — which are the same company. The rudeness about this has been astonishing. If they treat a 23-year customer this way, how will they treat you? Stay far away from their member presentations — the benefits are clearly worthless.

response.text: Thank you for your long-standing loyalty and for sharing this feedback. We sincerely apologize for the confusion regarding your membership benefits. This is not the level of attention we strive to provide and your comments have been shared with the appropriate teams for immediate review.

reviews.name: Jason F
reviews.text: Marketed as luxury, but operationally broken. Restaurant reservations were either non-existent or couldn't be located by hosts. We observed restaurants with empty tables while being told no availability existed. Room service was quoted at two-hour wait times; when it arrived, food quality was inedible. The gym had sand on the floors and outdated equipment. The shuttle was unreliable across this 3-mile property. We departed early at our own expense. Some staff were courteous, but the operation simply did not match the premium price.

response.text: We sincerely regret that your experience did not meet expectations and that you chose to depart early. Your detailed feedback regarding dining coordination, transportation, and facilities has been shared with all relevant departments for immediate review. We are committed to improving these areas.

reviews.name: Mark P
reviews.text: The resort is nice but part of a very large sprawling complex. Shuttle service was often full with members getting priority. Restaurants fill up fast — we could only secure 3 reservations, nothing before 8pm. When we arrived at our reservation times, restaurants were half-full. The Santa Fe steakhouse served tough, overcooked steak with staff more focused on pushing expensive wine. Best parts: Fuentes dinner theater (worth every penny of the upcharge), the spa, pool bartender at building 28, and housekeeper Sandra who was exceptional.

reviews.name: Michael M
reviews.text: The food is honestly the best we've experienced at any all-inclusive resort. Staff are wonderful and warm. However, the resort stretches nearly 3 miles end-to-end and transportation is inconsistent. The beach is disappointing — concrete barriers and a rocky reef make it impossible to actually swim. The pools were extremely cold throughout our visit, with hardly anyone in the water despite crowds around the pool deck. Despite the constant wind and cold pools, it's a beautiful resort with great food.

response.text: Thank you for your balanced and detailed review. We're pleased you enjoyed the food and warm service. Your feedback regarding pool temperature, beach access, and transportation availability is greatly valued and has been shared with our operations teams.

reviews.name: lytsout1
reviews.text: We got married here 15 years ago and this is our 6th visit — our only non-5-star review. The resort is still fabulous: rooms feel dated but the outdoor shower alone is worth the price, and Fuentes dinner theater is great every time. Our specific issue was tipping. On three occasions an employee deliberately called us names in Spanish when we didn't tip. Management needs to urgently clarify the tipping policy: tips should be included in all-inclusive and should never be expected or demanded.

response.text: Thank you for your continued loyalty and for sharing this candid feedback. Any behavior that makes a guest feel uncomfortable is completely unacceptable. Your comments have been addressed directly with our leadership team to reinforce our standards of professionalism and respect at all times.

reviews.name: bckrause
reviews.text: We've been coming to EDCR for New Year's for the past 12 years, and this was one of our best visits yet. Casita butlers Hector and Miriam could not have been better — they went well beyond the norm to make our stay truly memorable. Section 32 bartender Alberto and beach butler Alberto were both fantastic keeping us hydrated wherever we were. Even Karen and Claudio — not our assigned butlers — helped us at every turn. Concierge Emi rounded it all out.

response.text: Thank you for 12 years of New Year's celebrations with us! We are thrilled this was one of your best stays yet. Hector, Miriam, both Albertos, Karen, Claudio, and Emi will be delighted to hear of your kind recognition.

reviews.name: Dan
reviews.text: Our stay was defined by truly outstanding service. Shoutout to Benjamin, David, and concierge Reina for making everything seamless. The food was world-class: the beef curry at Jade may be the best I've ever had; Fuentes restaurant theater paired with a phenomenal guitarist was worth every extra cent. Casual options at Kick (burgers) and The Spot (tacos) were also excellent. Rooms were spotless. The catamaran snorkeling at Maroma Beach was wonderful — we even spotted a large sea turtle.

response.text: Thank you for your thoughtful and detailed review! We are delighted you enjoyed the outstanding service from our team, the culinary experiences, and the Maroma Beach excursion. Benjamin, David, and Reina will be thrilled by your kind words.

reviews.name: Miji14
reviews.text: This is our 10th visit here! Concierge Wilma was absolutely fantastic — she stopped by the pool twice daily to check on us, bringing waters, chips, and Bueno bars. Luis at Santa Fe remembered our exact coffee and juice preferences. Rodrigo at D'Italia Casitas brought out a delicious off-menu pasta just for us. Pool bartender Manuel kept our cups filled all week. It really is the people that make this place — are there occasional glitches? Sure, but 9 times out of 10 someone will go above and beyond.

response.text: Thank you for your incredible loyalty — 10 visits means the world to us! We are delighted you had another wonderful stay. Wilma, Luis, Rodrigo, and Manuel will be so pleased to hear of your recognition.

reviews.name: Lorraine V
reviews.text: This was our 5th or 6th time at this resort and, again, it did not disappoint! We love this resort and the people who work here! The beach is not the best — you really can't go into the water due to the massive amount of seaweed — but there were plenty of pools to cool off in. All of the food we had was so good — Kampai was our favourite, followed by Santa Fe and D'Italia. We also did the sunset dinner cruise at Maroma and it was amazing! What really makes this resort stand out are the employees. Emiliano (our concierge in Bldg. 32) was AMAZING — he made our trip so special and remembered us immediately from our last trip. Benjamin at the pool bar got Baileys from Santa Fe just so he could make our mini-beers the way we liked them — now THAT is service! Tony was very knowledgeable about our membership. El Fredo recognised us after over a year! This is why we can't wait to return.

response.text: Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed and heartfelt review. It truly means the world to us to welcome you back for your 5th or 6th visit. We are especially grateful for your kind recognition of Emiliano, Benjamin, Tony, and El Fredo. Creating memorable experiences through genuine service is what we strive for every day.

reviews.name: Kate E
reviews.text: Just got back from another amazing vacation at this resort. So relaxing with everything taken care of. The people and service are amazing here. Special shout out to our butlers Claudio and Paul who were amazing. Clean rooms, great food especially at Italian Casitas, and beautiful resort areas to enjoy. Thanks and see you next year!

response.text: Thank you for your perfect rating. We're delighted you enjoyed your stay and hope to welcome you back soon.

reviews.name: 575dgc
reviews.text: I would have given 5 stars because we had a great holiday. However, the casitas were in a poor state of repair — we wasted the first day re-packing and changing rooms due to very noisy repairs going on to the thatched roof and wooden stairs of the casitas next door. The suites were tired-looking with worn taps and mirrors. We paid a premium price but the quality didn't match. That said, the layout was great, very spacious, and the view from the balcony was lovely. The bed was enormous and so comfortable. Loved the outside shower and the hot tub. The food and restaurants and bars were absolutely excellent. Staff were friendly and helpful. The entertainment was of a high standard and the grounds and gardens were beautiful and very well maintained.

response.text: Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback. We are pleased to know that you enjoyed many aspects of your stay including the spacious accommodations, comfortable bed, beautiful grounds, and the quality of our food and entertainment. We sincerely regret the inconveniences you experienced with the maintenance work. Your observations have been shared with our facilities and renovation teams.

reviews.name: jt409
reviews.text: We had a great time at the Casitas! The rooms were clean and quiet, and the staff did a great job every day keeping them that way with a fully stocked mini fridge. The food was good with many different options for a wide variety of tastes. The shows were fun and entertainment was really well done. The beach is where it starts to lose it for me though — if you are a beach lover this is not the place for you. Overall: staff were amazing, our pool bartender Juan was great all week, everyone was friendly from the groundskeepers to the bartenders. We had a few issues with our casita and they made sure to remedy them immediately. If you're looking for a nice place with good food and decent entertainment I would definitely recommend.

response.text: Thank you for sharing your kind feedback about your recent stay. We are delighted to know that you had a great overall experience. It is especially rewarding to hear your recognition of our team, including Juan at the pool bar. We also appreciate your comments regarding the beach access and entertainment preferences. We truly look forward to welcoming you back.

reviews.name: LindaB884
reviews.text: Another awesome vacation at El Dorado Casitas! We stayed 11 days and enjoyed every minute! Our butlers Pablo and Fernando were attentive and very helpful! The food was excellent as usual — our favourite was D'Italia Casitas with Jade a close 2nd. Our favourite waiter was Wilbert at La Isla. We enjoyed massages by Regina and Janeth which contributed to our relaxation! We went to the top of Generations to see the lunar eclipse (Blood Moon) — amazing! Members for 17 years and loving it!

response.text: Thank you for sharing your wonderful feedback and for your continued loyalty. We are truly delighted to know that you had another amazing stay and that our team, including Pablo, Fernando, and Wilbert, provided attentive and helpful service throughout. We look forward to welcoming you back for many more memorable stays.

reviews.name: Dan C
reviews.text: My wife and I just got back from what we thought would be a relaxing stay at El Dorado Casitas Royale, but it turned into such a letdown that we both agreed we would never go back. On our first night the check-in concierge told us the only place open was the pizza spot with literally just four kinds of pizza. We were starving after traveling. Room service was even worse — we ordered one night and waited two full hours for it to arrive cold. The room itself had plenty of problems. Very expensive for the value you get.

response.text: We are very sorry to hear about your experience and that we fell short of your expectations. These concerns do not reflect our standards and we would like to investigate further. Please contact us directly so we can address these issues. We hope to have the opportunity to restore your confidence in us.

reviews.name: SunseekersCA
reviews.text: We have stayed at many all-inclusives in the Riviera Maya and this is by far the most romantic and private. The individual casitas surrounded by tropical vegetation with a personal plunge pool is a concept that no other resort in the area matches. Butler service was extraordinary. Food quality rivals standalone restaurants. A truly special place for couples seeking a romantic, secluded feel within a larger resort.
